endpoint_header: {label} STABLE SCENE FACTS (endpoint Subject numbers are historical, NOT current H3 labels):
start_frame_note: LLM image #{ordinal} (after {picture_count} numbered Picture reference(s)) is the DIRECTOR-ONLY START continuity frame. It is physical truth for the inherited visible seam state and is NOT an H3 <Picture N> reference.
target_frame_note: LLM image #{ordinal} (after {picture_count} numbered Picture reference(s)) is the DIRECTOR-ONLY TARGET continuity frame. It is physical truth for the required arrival state and is NOT an H3 <Picture N> reference.
missing_frame_note: {role} continuity endpoint detected, but its boundary frame is unavailable.
endpoint_numbering_rule: Endpoint Subject numbers are historical only; use current reference_contract for H3 Subject labels.
reference_identity_rule: POV/viewer/camera-holder semantics do not create a Subject; only reference-backed Subject labels are allowed.
